lessons.title: Fire
lessons.summary: Flames rise, flicker and break off.

steps.title: Flames rise and flicker
steps.text: Fire is always moving up. The bottom of a flame stays put, the middle waves side to side, and the tips stretch up, break off and disappear. Animate it as a loop of 6 to 8 frames, drawn straight ahead.

steps.title: Draw a flame
steps.text: Trace the flame: one big outer shape and a smaller one inside.
steps.hint: Start at the bottom, sweep up one side to the tip, then down the other side.

steps.title: Flicker loop
steps.text: Draw the outer flame on 4 frames. Watch the wave travel up. Frame 4 leads into frame 1.
steps.hint: The bottom barely moves. The tip moves the most.

quiz.question: Which way do flames move?
choices: Up, with tips that break off
quiz.explain: Hot air rises, so flames reach upward and break off at the top.

lessons.title: Smoke
lessons.summary: Puffs that grow, slow down and drift.

steps.title: Puffs that grow and slow
steps.text: Smoke starts small and fast near where it comes from. As it rises, each puff grows bigger, slows down, drifts with the wind and fades away.

steps.title: One puff
steps.text: Draw one puff rising. It grows each frame, and the gaps get smaller as it slows down.
steps.hint: Big jump first, then smaller and smaller jumps.

quiz.question: As a smoke puff rises, it should...
quiz.explain: Smoke spreads out and loses speed as it rises.

steps.title: The splash
steps.text: When a drop hits water, it speeds up as it falls, then water jumps up in a crown, droplets fly out in arcs and fall back down (gravity again!), and rings of ripples spread out.

steps.title: The crown
steps.text: Trace the crown of water and the flying droplets.
steps.hint: Draw the crown's spiky top first.

steps.title: Ripples
steps.text: Draw a ripple ring growing outward on each frame.
steps.hint: Each ring is wider than the last, and flatter than a circle.

quiz.question: After droplets fly up, they...
choices: Fall back down in curved arcs
quiz.explain: Gravity bends their paths into arcs.

lessons.title: Sparkles
lessons.summary: Pop in, flash and shrink away.

steps.title: Twinkle
steps.text: Sparkles are quick: they pop in, flash at their biggest and shrink away. Give each sparkle different timing so they don't all twinkle at once.

steps.title: Pop and shrink
steps.text: Draw one sparkle small, then at its biggest, then shrinking.
steps.hint: Four long points with skinny curves between them.

quiz.question: Why give each sparkle different timing?
choices: So they don't all blink at once, which looks fake
quiz.explain: Nature is a little random. Offset timing feels natural.
